name: Disability Pension for the Construction Workers
benefit: - ₹3,000/- per month as disability pension to permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, T.B., accident etc. available from the date of registration.
_eligibility_text: **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. **For Application** - The applicant should be permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, T.B., accident etc.
